secretH.q1: What do their eyes do when you're in the same room?
secretH.q1a: Nothing special, he looks at me the way he looks at everyone.
secretH.q1b: Our eyes meet now and then, like anyone's would.
secretH.q1c: I often catch him looking at me, and he looks away.
secretH.q1d: He looks for my reaction whenever he says something funny.
secretH.q2: Does he remember things you only said once?
secretH.q2a: No, I usually have to repeat myself.
secretH.q2b: The broad strokes, like any friend would.
secretH.q2c: Yes, precise details that surprise me when he brings them back up.
secretH.q2d: He remembers even things I said in passing, without thinking.
secretH.q3: How do the two of you end up alone together, usually?
secretH.q3b: When chance works out that way, nothing more.
secretH.q3c: He often suggests one-to-one occasions: a coffee, a lift, a favour.
secretH.q3d: He invents excuses, and it shows a little.
secretH.q4: Is he the same with you in a group as one to one?
secretH.q4b: A bit more relaxed one to one, but nothing striking.
secretH.q4c: One to one he opens up far more, and in a group he goes neutral again.
secretH.q4d: In a group he almost deliberately keeps his distance from me.
secretH.q5: What happens with the physical distance between you?
secretH.q5a: Nothing, we keep the same distance as with everyone else.
secretH.q5b: We greet each other, nothing more.
secretH.q5c: He often ends up next to me, and stays closer than necessary.
secretH.q5d: He finds small excuses for contact, a hand on the arm, a shoulder.
secretH.q6: What do their replies to your messages look like?
secretH.q6a: Short, and sometimes he forgets to answer.
secretH.q6b: Normal, no faster and no longer than with anyone else.
secretH.q6c: Often very fast, and often longer than my own message.
secretH.q6d: He restarts the conversation when it stops, even over nothing.
secretH.q7: What does he do when you talk about someone you like?
secretH.q7a: He asks questions, it seems to amuse him.
secretH.q7b: They listen, with no particular reaction.
secretH.q7c: He changes the subject, or goes very quiet all of a sudden.
secretH.q7d: He criticises the person, or finds a flaw every time.
secretH.q8: How do the people around them behave when you show up?
secretH.q8a: Normally, I don't really know their friends.
secretH.q8c: There are sideways smiles, or a silence when I arrive.
secretH.q8d: Someone has already teased me about it, or hinted at something.
secretH.q9: What does he actually talk to you about?
secretH.q9b: Their day, their plans, nothing very personal.
secretH.q9c: He tells me things he doesn't tell other people.
secretH.q9d: He compliments me on who I am rather than on how I look.
secretH.q10: And you, what brought you here?
secretH.q10b: A remark from a friend that put the idea in my head.
secretH.q10c: A feeling that keeps coming back over the last few weeks.
secretH.q10d: I'm almost sure of it, but he has never said a word.
secretH.modesDesc: The questions adapt to the person you have in mind.
secretH.modeHommeDesc: The questions will be about him.
secretH.modeFemmeDesc: The questions will be about her.
